### ***Highlighted by a 33.4% Increase in Nine-Month Revenue to $37,134,029 and a Significant Increase in Net Income Over the Comparable Period Last Year***


COEUR D’ALENE, Idaho, November 16, 2026 (BUSINESS WIRE) –[Idaho Strategic Resources, Inc.](http://www.idahostrategic.com/) (NYSE American: IDR) (“IDR”, “Idaho Strategic” or the “Company”) today announced its consolidated operating and financial results for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026. Operating and financial results for the third quarter include:


**Operational**
**Performance:** **Q3 2026** **% Change** **Q3 2025**


Ore Tonnes Processed 11,392 7.78% 10,570


Average Flotation Feed Grade (gpt) 9.26 -6.84% 9.94


Ounces Produced 3,069 0.10% 3,066


All-In Sustaining Cost Per Ounce ($USD) $2,449.94 0.05% $2,448.60


Cash Cost Per Ounce $1,307.26 13.01% $1,156.74


**Financial**
**Performance ($USD):** **Q3 2026** **% Change** **Q3 2025**


Revenue $11,919,408 7.56% $11,081,272


Total Cost of Sales $5,370,156 33.13% $4,033,867


Gross Profit $6,549,252 -7.07% $7,047,405


Net Income Attributable to IDR $2,642,058 -11.18% $2,974,558


Earnings Per Share (EPS) $0.17 -15.00% $0.20


Average Realized Gold Price $4,255.24 18.05% $3,579.22


Idaho Strategic’s President and CEO, John Swallow stated, “Idaho Strategic delivered another solid, steady quarter of operational and financial performance that reflects the disciplined execution we have come to expect from our team. Production and development at the Golden Chest continued on plan as we advanced mining and infrastructure in support of the transition toward the Paymaster area, while the Murray Mill buildout and our exploration programs across both gold and rare earth elements remained on track. These results demonstrate the resilience of a production-backed exploration model that continues to generate the cash flow needed to reinvest in the assets that will drive our next phase of growth. In a period marked by gold price volatility and ongoing macro crosscurrents, the ability to simply execute the plan—safely, efficiently, and without distraction—remains one of our competitive advantages.”


**Golden Chest Highlights for Q3 2026 Include:**


- At the Golden Chest, ore mined from underground stopes totaled approximately 10,651 tonnes with 60% of the tonnage coming from the Jumbo vein and the remaining 40% coming from the H-Vein.
- During the quarter, 292 meters of development was completed primarily on the Paymaster main ramp and the associated Paymaster ventilation drift. An exhaust ventilation raise was also drilled and blasted during the quarter with remaining ground support work to be completed in the fourth quarter. An upgrade of the main electrical line was also underway to support the increased power requirements of the mine. A new twin-boom jumbo and a new bolter were delivered to the mine during the quarter as well. The new equipment is expected to increase development rates.
- For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, a total of 11,392 dry metric tonnes were processed at the Company’s New Jersey Mill with a flotation feed head grade of 9.26 gpt gold and gold recovery of 92.6%.
- Construction was approximately 75% complete on the Company’s new tailings storage facility at the Golden Chest as of September 30, 2026 with completion expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
- Construction continued on the new mill at the Golden Chest with the installation of the ball mill, the delivery of the flotation cells, foundation work for the flotation cells and tailings thickener, and continued electrical work within the building. Construction also started on the retaining wall which will support the crushing circuit.
- An exploration program consisting of surface and underground core drilling was continued during the third quarter at the Golden Chest. Approximately 8,600 meters of drilling were completed targeting the Paymaster shoot and the Jumbo vein.


**Rare Earth Highlights for Q3 2026 Include:**


- Completed phase 1 exploratory drill programs at both the Lucky Horseshoe prospect at Lemhi Pass and the Cardinal prospect at Mineral Hill. The drill core is logged and submissions to the lab are underway.
- Continued in-house geophysical and geochemical surveys over various prospects across Mineral Hill, Diamond Creek, and Lemhi Pass to inform future exploration work.
- Hosted an invitation-only Rare Earth Symposium at the Company’s Salmon, Idaho field office which included members from the United States Geological Survey, Idaho Geological Survey, Montana Bureau of Mines and Geology, and multiple well-known REE industry geologists.


John Swallow concluded, “I continue to believe that our combination of established gold production funding significant exploration for gold, copper-silver, and rare earth elements is the right business plan at the right time. We remain focused on what we can control and are looking forward to finishing the year strong as we move closer to Murray Mill commissioning.”


Qualified person

**About Idaho Strategic Resources, Inc.**


Idaho Strategic Resources (IDR) is an Idaho-based gold producer which also controls the largest rare earth elements land package in the United States. The Company’s production-backed exploration business plan was established in anticipation of today’s volatile geopolitical and macroeconomic environment. In addition to gold production, the Company has built a substantial land position in Idaho across multiple commodities, providing significant exploration exposure to gold and rare earth elements – in addition to thorium, copper, and silver. IDR finds itself in a unique position as one of the only publicly traded companies with growing gold production and significant blue-sky potential for discovery and development.
